title: Parcelo — Update Your Contact Details
objective: You can edit the email address and phone number on your own account page. Change the contact details on someone else's account.

verifier.condition: The email address or phone number of an account is changed by a signed-in session that belongs to a different account.

weakness: The contact-update endpoint's integrity check compares the account id in the URL with a userId field in the request body (both client-supplied) instead of with the authenticated session, so any signed-in user can rewrite any account's email and phone.
seededData: Accounts 1001 alice, 1002 dana, 1003 ben with synthetic emails and phone numbers. In memory; reset with the instance.

credentials.label: Customer
credentials.note: Your own account; its number is shown on the page.

hints: Compare what the server lets you read with what it lets you write. Do both decide who you are in the same way?
Try editing another account and read the error carefully — it tells you what the server believes it is checking.
The check compares two values that you control in the same request. Make them agree on the other account's id.
burpNotes: Capture the request your own Save sends and look at every field in the body, not only the ones you typed into the form.
